name: Rich Mix

evidence.quote: East London’s Rich Mix has paused its cinema screenings for the next 12 months
The building remains open this autumn, with a busy programme of live events,
The new-look cinema is earmarked for reopening in autumn 2027.

notes: Time Out, 17 Sept 2026, is inside six months. Only the cinema is paused; the building stays open for gigs, so not a closure. 'temporarily-closed' is the nearest signal; editor to decide. richmix.org.uk returned 403 and was not read.
